abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Heart.

Beguilding pheromones: Once per session, when trying to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} someone, and if you use your pheromones, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2). If you do, set your action die to 6, and roll your challenge dice. And if you ever use your pheromones to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.05909d6310d209a6]{Make a Connection} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.287bb4c2b53ea847]{Forge a Bond}, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2) to reroll any dice.
